metadata.question: Does cloud cover increase in Western Australia (specifically (-20.59, 125.93)) between 11:00 and 14:00 local time on January 14, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point(-20.59, 125.93) in Western Australia - Date: January 14, 2020 - Time: 11:00 to 14:00 local time (Western Australia is UTC+8, so this is 03:00-06:00 UTC) - Need geostationary satellite data for same-day hourly observations: Himawari-8 - Collection: "JAXA/HIMAWARI/AHI_BAND_USAGE_SYNTHESIZED/L2_CLOUD_PROPERTY" 2. Masking strategy: - This question IS about clouds, so we should NOT mask clouds - We need to measure cloud cover percentage at two different times - Use cloud mask band to calculate cloud percentage 3. Logic: - Get images at ~11:00 local (03:00 UTC) and ~14:00 local (06:00 UTC) - Calculate cloud cover percentage for each time - Compare: if 14:00 cloud cover > 11:00 cloud cover, answer A (Yes) - Valid zero is possible (0% clouds is valid) - Check for C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([125.93, -20.59]); const region = point.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer for analysis // Western Australia is UTC+8 // 11:00 local = 03:00 UTC, 14:00 local = 06:00 UTC const date = '2020-01-14'; const time1Start = ee.Date(date + 'T03:00:00'); const time1End = ee.Date(date + 'T03:30:00'); const time2Start = ee.Date(date + 'T06:00:00'); const time2End = ee.Date(date + 'T06:30:00'); // 2. Data Acquisition - Himawari-8 for high temporal resolution const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('JAXA/HIMAWARI/AHI_BAND_USAGE_SYNTHESIZED/L2_CLOUD_PROPERTY') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(time1Start, time1End); const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('JAXA/HIMAWARI/AHI_BAND_USAGE_SYNTHESIZED/L2_CLOUD_PROPERTY') .filterBounds(point) .filterDate(time2Start, time2End); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`11:00 local images: ${size1}`); console.log(`14:00 local images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both time periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate cloud cover percentage const img1 = col1.first(); const img2 = col2.first(); // Cloud mask band: 1 = cloudy, 0 = clear const cloudMask1 = img1.select('cloud_mask'); const cloudMask2 = img2.select('cloud_mask'); // Calculate statistics const stats1 = await cloudMask1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 2000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await cloudMask2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 2000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const cloudCover1 = stats1.cloud_mask_mean; const count1 = stats1.cloud_mask_count; const cloudCover2 = stats2.cloud_mask_mean; const count2 = stats2.cloud_mask_count; console.log(`11:00 local: Cloud cover = ${(cloudCover1 * 100).toFixed(1)}%, Pixels = ${count1}`); console.log(`14:00 local: Cloud cover = ${(cloudCover2 * 100).toFixed(1)}%, Pixels = ${count2}`); // 4. Validation if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels in analysis region."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (cloudCover1 === null || cloudCover2 === null || cloudCover1 === undefined || cloudCover2 === undefined || isNaN(cloudCover1) || isNaN(cloudCover2)) { console.log("Calculation failure - invalid values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Final Answer const increase = cloudCover2 - cloudCover1; console.log(`Change: ${(increase * 100).toFixed(1)}% (${increase > 0 ? 'increase' : 'decrease'})`); if (cloudCover2 > cloudCover1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
